title: From Reactive to Agentic Resilience: Multi-Timescale AI-RAN Orchestration Under Signaling Storms
title_zh: 从被动韧性到智能体韧性：信令风暴下的多时间尺度AI-RAN编排

paragraphs.en: Next-generation open radio access network (Open RAN) and AI-RAN deployments turn the RAN into a disaggregated, compute-aware platform whose service continuity depends on many control loops acting at different timescales. Resilience in this setting is best seen as a lifecycle spanning anticipation, absorption, adaptation, recovery, and evolution. Yet, existing mechanisms remain stage-specific and are rarely coordinated across the control hierarchy. This paper argues that agentic AI offers an orchestration layer that coordinates this lifecycle, turning operator intent into coordinated action while keeping slow language-model reasoning off the fast control path. Using mass-attachment signaling storms as a running study, we build a discrete-event Open RAN attach simulator that captures retry amplification, shared-compute contention, and non-instantaneous provisioning, and we propose a three-tier framework in which an orchestrator at the service management and orchestration layer sets a standing policy, a per-site non-real-time agent judges storms and anticipates scheduled crowds, and a deterministic near-real-time loop enforces every decision. Across experiments, the agentic controller approaches the resilience of a fully provisioned pool of servers at a quarter of its capacity by reading a scheduled event from a calendar and provisioning ahead of it. No reactive weight setting recovers this once the surge arrives. Free-text operator intents ground into control directives at 94 % 94\% exact match on previously unseen intents, and a single instruction reshapes live behavior end to end. We also quantify the latency, cost, and contention limits that bound it. The simulator, the proposed agentic framework, and the agent prompts are publicly available on GitHub . The supplementary material provides analytical proof of the derived Theorem on anticipation horizon, as well as the subsequent Corollary results on reactive provisioning limits.

paragraphs.en: Building on the foundations of open radio access networks (Open RAN) [ 1 ] , AI-RAN advances the evolution toward AI-native operation by enabling higher levels of automation and orchestration, and the co-execution of radio access network (RAN) and AI workloads on shared edge infrastructure. As a result, the RAN is evolving from a communication-centric platform into an intelligent, compute-aware, and dynamically orchestrated system [ 2 , 3 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在开放无线接入网（Open RAN）[ 1 ] 的基础上，AI-RAN 通过实现更高级别的自动化与编排，以及无线接入网（RAN）与 AI 工作负载在共享边缘基础设施上的协同执行，推动向 AI 原生运营的演进。 因此，RAN 正在从一个以通信为中心的平台演变为智能化的、具备计算感知能力且可动态编排的系统 [ 2 , 3 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In this setting, resilience becomes a fundamental requirement that extends beyond traditional redundancy and fault tolerance [ 4 ] , since in Open RAN and AI-RAN service continuity depends on coordinated behavior across disaggregated components, open interfaces, and control loops operating at different timescales [ 5 ] . Network resilience is thus best understood not as a single mechanism but as a lifecycle. The literature decomposes it into four interdependent stages: anticipation of emerging threats, absorption of their impact while acceptable service is preserved, adaptation under degraded or adversarial conditions, and recovery of stable operation [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] . We propose a fifth, evolution , capturing what a system carries forward from one disruption to the next.
paragraphs.zh: 在此背景下，韧性成为一项超越传统冗余与容错的基本要求 [ 4 ] ，因为在 Open RAN 和 AI-RAN 中，业务连续性依赖于跨分解组件、开放接口以及在不同时间尺度上运行的控制回路的协同行为 [ 5 ] 。 因此，网络韧性最好被理解为不是一个单一机制，而是一个生命周期。 文献将其分解为四个相互依存的阶段：对新兴威胁的预判、在可接受业务得以保留的同时吸收其影响、在降级或对抗性条件下的适应，以及恢复稳定运行 [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] 。 我们提出第五个阶段——演化，用以刻画系统从一次扰动到下一次扰动所沉淀并延续下来的东西。

paragraphs.en: Existing literature has made significant progress on individual resilience functions across the anticipation, absorption, adaptation, and recovery stages. Predictive analytics and digital twins support anticipation [ 10 , 11 ] . Anomaly detection, fault isolation, and access control mechanisms support absorption [ 12 ] . Resource allocation, virtual network function provisioning, and network slicing support adaptation [ 13 ] , and self-healing mechanisms support recovery. However, these capabilities are typically studied as stage-specific or mechanism-specific solutions, with limited attention to how they can be systematically related and orchestrated across the disaggregated control hierarchy of Open RAN and AI-RAN. This paper addresses that gap by treating resilience as one continuous lifecycle and examining agentic orchestration as a unifying layer for coordinating its stages.
paragraphs.zh: 现有文献在预期、吸收、适应和恢复各阶段的个体韧性函数方面已取得显著进展。 预测分析与数字孪生支持预期阶段 [ 10 , 11 ] 。 异常检测、故障隔离和访问控制机制支持吸收阶段 [ 12 ] 。 资源分配、虚拟网络功能配置和网络切片支持适应阶段 [ 13 ] ，而自愈机制支持恢复阶段。 然而，这些能力通常作为特定阶段或特定机制的解决方案进行研究，对于如何在 Open RAN 和 AI-RAN 的解耦控制层级中对它们进行系统性关联与编排，关注仍然有限。 本文通过将韧性视为一个连续的生命周期，并将智能体编排作为协调其各阶段的统一层，来填补这一空白。

paragraphs.en: Agentic AI is well suited to this role. In contrast to isolated predictive or reactive models, it emphasizes goal-directed behavior, contextual reasoning, planning, tool use, and interaction among specialized agents. These properties are well aligned with resilience management, where decisions must integrate observations across multiple layers, reconcile local and global objectives, and sequence actions across heterogeneous network functions and timescales. In the context of AI-RAN, agentic AI is therefore better viewed as an orchestration layer over the intelligence hierarchy than as another analytics capability [ 14 , 15 , 16 ] . These capabilities, however, do not come for free. Embedding large language model (LLM)-based agents in closed-loop RAN control adds signaling, computation, and coordination overhead, and introduces new failure modes such as hallucinated or unsafe actions and adversarial manipulation of agent reasoning, all of which must be contained during deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式AI非常适合承担这一角色。 与孤立的预测性或反应式模型不同，它强调目标导向的行为、情境推理、规划、工具使用，以及专门化智能体之间的交互。 这些特性与韧性管理高度契合，因为在韧性管理中，决策必须整合跨多层的观测信息，协调局部与全局目标，并在异构网络功能和不同时间尺度上对动作进行排序。 因此，在AI-RAN的背景下，智能体式AI更适合被视为智能层级之上的编排层，而不是又一种分析能力 [ 14 , 15 , 16 ] 。 然而，这些能力并非没有代价。 将基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体嵌入闭环RAN控制会增加信令、计算和协调开销，并引入新的失效模式，例如幻觉式或不安全的动作以及对智能体推理的对抗性操纵，所有这些在部署时都必须加以遏制。

paragraphs.en: To ground this discussion, we consider signaling storm attacks in next-generation RAN as a motivating study. This scenario is particularly relevant because signaling storms can arise from compromised devices, bot-driven activity, or mass attachment scenarios, and can simultaneously disrupt control-plane stability, radio resource availability, and service continuity [ 17 , 18 ] . More importantly, the scenario naturally spans the full resilience lifecycle. As such, the study provides a concrete setting for illustrating how agentic orchestration can unify otherwise fragmented resilience mechanisms into a continuous control loop.

paragraphs.en: A multi-timescale agentic resilience orchestration algorithm. We propose a three-tier algorithm in which an intent orchestrator at the service management and orchestration (SMO) layer, a tool-augmented non-real-time (Non-RT) agent, and a deterministic near-real-time (Near-RT) control loop coordinate through a shared policy. The design combines contextual perception, reasoning, cross-episode memory, and hierarchical coordination while deliberately keeping probabilistic LLM inference outside the fast actuation path.
paragraphs.zh: 一种多时间尺度的智能体化韧性编排算法。 我们提出一种三层算法：位于服务管理与编排（SMO）层的意图编排器、一个工具增强的非实时（Non-RT）智能体，以及一个确定性的近实时（Near-RT）控制环路，通过共享策略进行协同。 该设计结合了情境感知、推理、跨回合记忆与分层协调，同时刻意将概率性的大语言模型（LLM）推理排除在快速执行路径之外。

paragraphs.en: Analytical guarantees on the value of anticipation. We derive and prove a sufficient minimum anticipation horizon under delayed capacity provisioning that guarantees the required capacity is online before a fast-onset surge and prevents backlog formation. We further prove that, when λ s > c ev ​ μ eff \lambda_{s}>c_{\mathrm{ev}}\,\mu_{\mathrm{eff}} and τ prov > 0 \tau_{\mathrm{prov}}>0 , no purely reactive capacity policy can avoid a strictly positive backlog during the provisioning ramp, irrespective of its optimization objective or controller weights. This identifies operating conditions under which only anticipation, informed by external context, can prevent service loss.
paragraphs.zh: 对预判价值的分析性保证。 在延迟容量供给的条件下，我们推导并证明了一个充分的最小预判时间跨度，该跨度保证在快速起始的需求激增到来之前所需容量已上线，并防止积压的形成。 我们进一步证明，当 λ s > c ev ​ μ eff \lambda_{s}>c_{\mathrm{ev}}\,\mu_{\mathrm{eff}} 且 τ prov > 0 \tau_{\mathrm{prov}}>0 时，任何纯响应式的容量策略都无法在供给爬坡期间避免严格为正的积压，无论其优化目标或控制器权重如何。 这明确了在哪些运行条件下，只有借助外部情境信息的预判才能防止服务损失。

paragraphs.en: An end-to-end evaluation of agentic reasoning and orchestration. We evaluate several LLMs as the Non-RT agent, and compare the proposed approach with static, reactive Lyapunov, and rule-based controllers. We test reserve sizing on real scheduled events, show how provisioning delay and hidden compute contention limit every controller, and evaluate free-text intent grounding, compounded stressors, and multi-site orchestration. Throughout, we report resilience and benign attached rate alongside capacity efficiency, inference latency, and monetary cost, and we analyze the signaling overhead the agent adds.
paragraphs.zh: 对智能体化推理与编排的端到端评估。 我们将多个大语言模型评估为非实时（Non-RT）智能体，并将所提方法与静态控制器、反应式 Lyapunov 控制器以及基于规则的控制器进行比较。 我们在真实的预定事件上测试备用容量配置，展示配置延迟与隐藏的计算争用如何限制所有控制器，并评估自由文本意图对齐、复合压力因素以及多站点编排。 在整个过程中，我们在报告容量效率、推理延迟和货币成本的同时，还报告了韧性与良性附带率，并分析了智能体所带来的信令开销。

paragraphs.en: Threat model. The surge in attachment requests may be non-malicious, arising from mass reconnection after an outage or a large gathering, or adversarial. We accordingly split the arrival rate into a benign and a malicious component, λ ⁡ ( t ) = λ ben ​ ( t ) + λ mal ​ ( t ) \lambda(t)=\lambda_{\text{ben}}(t)+\lambda_{\text{mal}}(t) . In the adversarial case, an attacker drives compromised or bot-driven UEs that flood the control plane with legitimate-looking attach requests to deny service, without otherwise breaking the signaling protocol order. Benign surges must be absorbed and recovered from, whereas the malicious component can be identified and rate-limited at admission, motivating distinct responses. Flagging which arrivals are malicious is the task of an anomaly or intrusion detector, which we take as given and out of scope [ 12 ] , so we study the response rather than the detection. A deployed detector is imperfect. We therefore assume that a fraction α fp \alpha_{\text{fp}} of legitimate attach attempts is wrongly flagged as malicious, so whenever the filter is active, these are dropped along with the botnet traffic.

paragraphs.en: The M / M / c M/M/c model of Section II-A fixes arrivals externally and holds the service rate constant, so it misses three effects that dominate real storms and motivate a discrete-event model. The first is retry-driven amplification, where timed-out attempts re-enter as fresh load. The second is load-dependent service time, as the shared compute pool slows under contention. The third is non-instantaneous capacity provisioning, as new servers take time to come online. With all three disabled, the discrete-event model reduces to the analytical rate ( 3 ), so the two agree in the baseline case.
paragraphs.zh: 第 II-A 节的 M/M/c 模型将到达固定为外部给定，并保持服务速率恒定，因此忽略了主导真实风暴的三个效应，而这些效应正是构建离散事件模型的动机。 第一个是重试驱动的放大，即超时的尝试会作为新的负载重新进入系统。 第二个是负载相关的服务时间，即共享计算资源池在争用下会变慢。 第三个是非即时的容量供给，即新服务器需要时间才能上线。 在三者的效应全部禁用的情况下，离散事件模型退化为解析速率（3），因此两者在基线情形下一致。

paragraphs.en: Rule-based. Our strongest baseline replaces the agent’s language-model policy with a fixed decision tree over the same telemetry, isolating the value of language-model reasoning. Like the agentic framework, it runs on two timescales. A slow rule periodically sets the policy, and the reactive update ( 12 ) applies it at every control step. The rule flags the cell as elevated when λ ⁡ ( t ) \lambda(t) rises clearly above its resting baseline and, lacking a calendar, treats every elevated load as malicious. It then raises V V for headroom and engages the filter with a drop probability that grows with overload severity, hardening if utility keeps falling. It can also raise V V early when the forecast extrapolates an already rising trend. This is close to the best that hand-tuned rules can achieve on this telemetry, but its limit is structural, since it responds only once arrivals begin to climb, never before.
paragraphs.zh: 基于规则的。 我们最强的基线用同一遥测数据上的固定决策树替代智能体的语言模型策略，以隔离语言模型推理的价值。 与智能体框架一样，它在两个时间尺度上运行。 慢速规则周期性地设定策略，而响应式更新（12）在每个控制步应用该策略。 当 λ ⁡ ( t ) \lambda(t) 明显高于其静息基线时，该规则将该单元标记为升高状态；由于没有日历，它将每一次升高的负载都视为恶意的。 随后它提高 V V 以留出余量，并启用过滤器，其丢弃概率随过载严重程度增长；若效用持续下降，则进一步收紧。 当预测外推出一个已在上升的趋势时，它还可以提前提高 V V 。 这已经接近手工调校规则在此类遥测数据上所能达到的最佳水平，但其局限是结构性的：它只在到达量开始攀升之后才做出响应，而绝不会在此之前。

paragraphs.en: Per-window resilience. paragraphs.en: Realizing resilience as a continuous lifecycle rather than a set of stage-specific mechanisms requires a framework that binds those stages into one coordinated cycle and carries what is learned from each disruption into the next. Agentic AI is a natural candidate, but placing LLM-based agents inside the real-time or Near-RT control loops adds signaling and decision latency exactly when the network is overloaded. We therefore propose an agentic resilience framework that coordinates the lifecycle across coupled loops running at different timescales while keeping slow, probabilistic LLM reasoning off the fast control path. Following the O-RAN control hierarchy, the framework spans three tiers, shown in Fig. 1 . An SMO-level orchestrator turns operator intent into standing policy, a per-site Non-RT agent judges storm conditions, and a deterministic Near-RT loop enforces those decisions at every control step.

paragraphs.en: The Non-RT agent is the per-site decision maker, summarized in Algorithm 2 . Its input is the telemetry that the Near-RT loop of Algorithm 1 produces at every control step, and its output is a shared policy object that the same loop reads back at its next step. The two algorithms therefore form a closed loop, with Algorithm 2 deciding and Algorithm 1 enforcing. It runs on its own schedule every few seconds, apart from the fast control path, and it never acts on the network directly. At each assessment, it receives a summary of the recent telemetry together with its own previous verdict, shown in Fig. 2 . The summary reports how the arrival rate, the queue, and the retry rate have moved over the last window. Each signal is also tagged as leading or lagging. Arrivals and retries rise at storm onset, whereas the queue reacts only afterwards and is held down by the fast loop, so the agent should base its judgment on the leading signals. Feeding the previous verdict back keeps the decision steady and stops the agent from switching the storm state on and off on brief noise. To look beyond raw arrivals, the agent can also call a small set of tools over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) [ 23 ] that return the live episode logs, a short forecast of the arrival rate, and a calendar of planned events.

paragraphs.en: Forecast tool ( λ ^ \hat{\lambda} ). When the trend is rising, the agent can raise the headroom weight V V a few cycles early, so the Near-RT loop begins adding servers before the queue builds. paragraphs.en: The two loops never call each other. They communicate through a single shared policy object that the agent writes and the Near-RT loop reads, which lets them run at different speeds. The agent updates the policy whenever it finishes an assessment, while the fast loop reads a complete copy of it at every control step and never sees a half-written update. The policy holds four kinds of fields. The first are the operational levers, the storm verdict and the malicious drop probability, which are refreshed on every assessment. The second are the slower controller settings, the utility and cost weights and the queue-hold threshold, which change only when the agent decides to retune, so the controller does not keep shifting on every cycle. The third is the scheduled reserve, a number of servers to hold online ahead of a planned surge together with the time the surge is due, which the agent commits once for an event and the fast loop brings online just before it starts. The fourth are operator overrides set by the SMO orchestrator, such as a fixed weight posture or a minimum capacity floor, which take priority over the agent’s own tuning. Because the loop reads only this object, it keeps working correctly no matter when, or even whether, the agent updates it. paragraphs.en: The mechanisms above let the framework react and anticipate within a single storm. A further layer lets it improve across storms. The fast loop keeps a lightweight memory of each storm’s signature, its baseline rate, the level at which it engages, and the drop strength that contained it. Once a pattern is recognized, it can turn on the admission filter before the agent has ruled. This memory, along with the tuned controller settings, is carried across episodes, so a site that has already weathered a storm starts the next one configured for it rather than from defaults. Only this slow-moving state is kept. The live levers, which are decisions about the present, are always recomputed. Memory is disabled in all experiments of Section V to isolate within-storm behavior, and its evaluation is left to future work.

paragraphs.en: The orchestrator is the topmost tier and the interface between the human operator and the sites, shown in Algorithm 3 . Its outputs feed both lower tiers. The posture and floor it writes are read by the Near-RT loop of Algorithm 1 , while the calendar entry and standing instruction are consumed by the Non-RT agent of Algorithm 2 . Sitting at the SMO above the per-site agents, and it is event-driven, staying idle while the network runs normally and activating only when an operator issues an intent, so it adds no steady-state signaling or real-time latency. Its role is to turn free-text operator intents into a single standing directive that the lower tiers apply without further review. The directive carries five levers, the posture direction and an optional graded strength that together set the utility and cost weights, a hard capacity floor, a scheduled load event with its venue, sold-out status, and time, and a standing instruction that tells the site agent how to interpret conditions rather than change capacity. The orchestrator writes the posture and the floor into the shared policy as operator overrides, which take priority over the site agent’s own tuning, registers the named event on the calendar the site agent reads, and leaves the standing instruction for it to apply on every assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 编排器是最高层级，也是人类操作员与各站点之间的接口，如算法3所示。 它的输出同时馈送到下面两个层级。 它写入的姿态和下限由算法1的近实时（Near-RT）循环读取，而日历条目和常设指令则由算法2的非实时（Non-RT）智能体使用。 它位于各站点智能体之上的SMO层，是事件驱动的，在网络正常运行时保持空闲，仅在操作员发出意图时才被激活，因此不会增加稳态信令或实时时延。 它的作用是将操作员的自由文本意图转化为单一的常设指令，供下层层级直接执行而无需进一步审核。 该指令包含五个控制项：姿态方向和可选的分级强度（二者共同设定效用与成本权重）、硬性容量下限、包含场馆、售罄状态和时间的计划性负载事件，以及告诉站点智能体如何解读条件而非改变容量的常设指令。 编排器将姿态和下限作为操作员覆盖项写入共享策略，这些覆盖项的优先级高于站点智能体自身的调优；它还在站点智能体读取的日历上注册所命名的事件，并保留常设指令供其在每次评估时执行。

paragraphs.en: Sitting at the SMO above the sites, the orchestrator coordinates one or many of them from a single point. It decomposes one operator intent into heterogeneous per-site directives and dispatches them over the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol [ 24 ] , so a scheduled stadium egress raises the reserve only on the cells that serve it while a fleet-wide cost posture applies everywhere, reconciling one global objective with the local conditions of each site. Each site then runs its own Non-RT agent and Near-RT loop against the directive it receives, so coordination stays centralized at the SMO while enforcement stays local and independent.
paragraphs.zh: 编排器位于站点之上的SMO中，从单点协调一个或多个站点。 它将一个运营商意图分解为异构的每站点指令，并通过Agent2Agent（A2A）协议[ 24 ]进行分发，因此计划的体育场出流只会在服务该场馆的小区上提升预留，而全网范围的成本策略则处处适用，从而将全局目标与每个站点的本地条件相协调。 每个站点随后针对其收到的指令运行自己的非实时（Non-RT）智能体和近实时（Near-RT）环路，因此协调保持在SMO集中进行，而执行则保持本地化和独立。

paragraphs.en: Because one Non-RT agent runs per site every few seconds, model selection trades decision quality against latency and cost. We evaluate five efficient-tier LLMs, from the lightweight GPT-4o-Mini and CLAUDE-HAIKU-4.5 , through GEMINI-3.1-Flash-Lite , to the stronger QWEN3.7-Plus and GPT-5.4-Mini , each running as the Non-RT agent with full tool use over five seeds. The scenario has two back-to-back spikes of opposite kinds, a malicious botnet ramp that should be filtered and a scheduled public event that should be provisioned for rather than filtered. The calendar returns only a free-text line such as “England v Brazil, Wembley, not sold out”, so the agent must infer the turnout itself ( 83,664 83{,}664 , warranting a 13 13 -server reserve). Temperature is fixed at 0.0, except for GPT-5.4-Mini with reasoning enabled, which uses the provider default.
paragraphs.zh: 由于每个站点每隔几秒运行一个 Non-RT 智能体，模型选择需要在决策质量与延迟和成本之间权衡。 我们评估了五个高效档大语言模型，从轻量级的 GPT-4o-Mini 和 CLAUDE-HAIKU-4.5，到 GEMINI-3.1-Flash-Lite，再到更强的 QWEN3.7-Plus 和 GPT-5.4-Mini，每个模型都作为 Non-RT 智能体运行，在五个种子上启用完整的工具使用。 该场景包含两个连续出现但性质相反的突发：一个是应当被过滤的恶意僵尸网络流量攀升，另一个是应当为其 provision 资源而非过滤的预定公共活动。 日历只返回诸如“英格兰对阵巴西，温布利，未售罄”这样的自由文本行，因此智能体必须自行推断到场人数（83,664，需要预留 13 台服务器）。 温度固定为 0.0，但启用了推理功能的 GPT-5.4-Mini 除外，它使用提供商的默认设置。

paragraphs.en: The orchestrator maps a free-text intent to one OperatorDirective that downstream code applies without review, so we first test whether that mapping is faithful. We hold out 40 40 intents, worded and valued disjointly from the few-shot examples in the prompt. They cover the five levers, plain and oblique phrasing, lexical traps that name a concern only to waive it, multi-lever combinations, spelling noise, and vague inputs that must change nothing. Posture is scored by direction and graded strength by a lenient band, the floor must match exactly and stay null when absent, an event must fall within 60 60 s of its true time, and a delegation must appear exactly when requested. Setting an unrequested lever counts as an error, so hallucinated action is penalized as well as omission. We compare against a keyword matcher and a do-nothing baseline over three seeds.

paragraphs.en: The stressors do not simply add up, they trigger one another. To serve the event, the controller provisions a reserve, which fills the pool, raises occupancy, and depresses μ eff \mu_{\text{eff}} , so the reserve it committed delivers less capacity than planned and the surge it anticipated overruns it. The controller cannot correct for this, since it plans against the nominal μ \mu and never observes the slowdown. The effect is therefore felt only by controllers that fill the pool. The reactive Lyapunov and rule-based controllers are unchanged across severity, because they sit near two servers, below the contention knee, but they already fail the event for lack of anticipation. Every provisioning controller loses resilience, the fully provisioned static pool most of all ( Δ ​ P = − 13.4 \Delta P=-13.4 pp at a = 1.0 a{=}1.0 ), because holding all c max c_{\max} servers hot maximizes occupancy and slowdown. The loss is also asymmetric across the episode. The botnet window is untouched at every severity, because the botnet is filtered and never fills the pool, so the collapse concentrates in the event window where legitimate load must be carried. This qualifies the conclusion of Section V-B . Over-provisioning, the safe choice without contention, becomes the most exposed under it, losing the most resilience of any controller, whereas the agentic controllers, which size capacity to demand rather than fill the pool, lose least among the controllers that provision for the event ( Δ ​ P \Delta P of − 5.1 -5.1 to − 9.5 -9.5 pp at a = 1.0 a{=}1.0 ) and still serve more of the event than the static pool. No controller escapes a stressor outside its telemetry, but right-sizing capacity is less exposed to it than brute-force provisioning, a distinction only a compounded scenario reveals.

paragraphs.en: Two tiers use a language model, but only one does so continuously. The SMO orchestrator invokes an LLM to ground an operator intent, an event-driven action that stays idle and adds no recurring cost (Section III-F ). The Near-RT loop uses no model at all, solving the scalar objective ( 12 ) over c ∈ [ 1 , c max ] c\in[1,c_{\max}] at every step. The framework’s recurring cost is therefore the per-site Non-RT assessment reported in Table I . This cost is decoupled from data-plane scale, because each assessment consumes a fixed-size summary of the telemetry window and emits one policy struct, the same whether a cell serves ten or a thousand UEs, as arrivals, retries, and queues are aggregated into rates before the model sees them. The number of LLM invocations therefore grows with the number of sites and the assessment cadence, not with the UEs, cells, or DUs/CUs a site aggregates. The effective assessment cadence depends on the model, since each cycle is a 5 5 s waiting interval plus the decision latency. At the GEMINI-3.1-Flash-Lite operating point the roughly 3 3 s decision gives a cadence near 8 8 s, about 450 450 assessments per site per hour, and about $ 0.8 0.8 per site per hour at $ 0.0018 0.0018 per decision. GPT-5.4-Mini with reasoning takes about 23 23 s per decision, which stretches the cadence to near 28 28 s and, at $ 0.0123 0.0123 per decision, costs about $ 1.6 1.6 per site per hour. Cross-tier signaling is equally light, namely one small policy write per assessment from the Non-RT agent to the Near-RT loop and the rare operator intent, neither of which rides the data plane, so the framework adds no per-UE signaling. However, granting more autonomy to the orchestrator, for instance periodically probing the site agents to confirm they remain healthy and are acting as intended, would replace that idle steady state with a recurring health-check load that grows with the number of sites. As sites multiply, the single orchestrator decomposes one intent into per-site directives over A2A (Section V-H ), while each site runs an independent Non-RT and Near-RT loop, so N N sites are N N parallel loops with no central bottleneck and the agent’s latency off the fast path never delays actuation.

paragraphs.en: This paper treated resilience in AI-RAN as a single lifecycle, spanning anticipation, absorption, adaptation, recovery, and evolution, and asked whether agentic AI can coordinate it without destabilizing the fast control loops it depends on. We studied this on mass-attachment signaling storms, using a discrete-event simulator that captures retry amplification, shared-compute contention, and delayed provisioning. Our three-tier framework keeps language-model reasoning off the real-time path. An SMO orchestrator turns operator intent into policy, a per-site Non-RT agent judges storms and anticipates scheduled crowds, and a deterministic Near-RT loop enforces every decision.
paragraphs.zh: 本文将 AI-RAN 中的韧性视为一个单一生命周期，涵盖预见、吸收、适应、恢复与演进，并探讨了智能体式 AI 能否协调这一生命周期，而不破坏其所依赖的快速控制环路的稳定性。 我们在大规模附着信令风暴场景下研究这一问题，使用了一个能够刻画重试放大、共享计算资源争用以及延迟开通的离散事件仿真器。 我们的三层框架将语言模型推理从实时路径中剥离。 SMO 编排器将运营商意图转化为策略，每个站点的非实时（Non-RT）智能体判断风暴并预判计划内的突发人流，而确定性的近实时（Near-RT）环路则执行每一项决策。

paragraphs.en: Anticipation proves decisive. We showed analytically that, under delayed provisioning, no reactive policy can prevent backlog during a fast-onset surge, whatever its tuning. Consistent with this, the agentic controller reaches resilience above 85 % 85\% with about a quarter of the capacity of a fully provisioned pool, sizing reserves within about one server of the ideal for crowds whose turnout is never stated. Free-text intents ground into directives at 94 % 94\% exact match, and a single orchestrator routed every intent correctly across three concurrent sites. The limits are equally clear. Shared-compute contention, which the agent cannot observe, shifts the stability cliff from about 459 459 to 247 247 UEs/s, and model reasoning adds latency and cost.

paragraphs.en: Several directions remain open. The framework already includes a cross-episode memory for the evolution stage, whose evaluation we leave to a dedicated study of learning across disruptions. Scaling multi-site orchestration to larger fleets with richer inter-agent messaging is a natural next step, as is reducing the signaling and compute footprint of the agent, especially where it shares the pool with the radio functions it protects. Placing language-model agents in closed-loop control also raises safety and security concerns, from hallucinated actions to adversarial manipulation of agent reasoning, so strengthening the deterministic guardrails, rollback, and grounding that keep the probabilistic tier accountable is essential before deployment. Validating the framework on a real Open RAN testbed under live signaling load remains the ultimate test.
